title.narrative: Rural Development: Family Farming, Resilience and Markets project in Upper and Middle Guinea

description.narrative: The development objective is to sustainably increase the incomes of 65,000 family farms and their resilience to external shocks, including climate change, and to improve their nutritional status, along with their access to local, urban and regional markets in the 15 targeted prefectures from the regions of Upper and Middle Guinea that are the most affected by food insecurity. The Project targets young people and women as a priority.
